title: The renewed can and do bear good fruit
source_text: III. Quod autem illi qui sunt eo modo Christi spiritu innovati, & facti bonae arbores, ac, ut quandoque scriptura loquitur, arbores justitiae, possint opera bona sancta & justa facere, & reapse producant bonos ejusmodi fructus, qui Deo placeant atque accepti sint, res ita certa atque evidens est, ut de eo nemo ambigere possit, quin communi Christianorum sensui renunciet, & verbo Dei omnem authoritatem tollat.
pass_a_gloss: III. But that those who are in this way renewed by the spirit of Christ, & made good trees, &, as Scripture sometimes speaks, trees of righteousness, can do good holy & just works, & in fact produce good fruits of that kind, which please God & are accepted, is a thing so certain & evident, that no one can doubt of it, without renouncing the common sense of Christians, & taking away all authority from the word of God.
pass_b_english: Thesis III. Those whom Christ's Spirit has renewed in this way have become good trees, or, as Scripture sometimes puts it, trees of righteousness. They can do good, holy and just works, and they really do bear good fruit of this kind, fruit that pleases God and is accepted by him.
This is so certain and so plain that no one can question it without abandoning what all Christians commonly understand and stripping God's word of all authority.

lemmas.gloss: in fact produce good fruits of that kind
renounce the common sense of Christians

choices.why: Le Blanc's thesis: the works of the regenerate are truly, not just apparently, good, even though they are not perfect.
